description: Na₄As₂O₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five equivalent AsO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.42 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.80 Å. As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one AsO₄ tetrahedra and corners with five equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.67-1.80 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one As atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent As atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Na and one As atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₃As trigonal pyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one As atom.
